title: MPU-6050 IMU, register level

implements.text: Registers 0x3B to 0x48 (accel, temperature, gyro), PWR_MGMT_1 sleep bit, WHO_AM_I 0x68; address 0x68 or 0x69
16384 LSB per g at the default range

unsupported.text: Bus time: a transfer completes instantly; pull-ups, clock stretching and repeated start are not modelled
FIFO, interrupts and the digital motion processor

parameterSources.note: default range; datasheet page not cited

validation.dataset: src/lib/interp/arduino/arduino.test.ts: MPU-6050 over raw Wire reads 1 g on Z after waking it

knownFailureCases: The register values are derived from the same constants the test checks, so the test cannot catch a wrong constant
